prompt:
Warm editorial storybook illustration, soft painterly line and gentle shading, muted natural palette on a warm cream ground. Picture-book register for adults. NEVER comic, NEVER cartoon, NEVER flat vector, NEVER photoreal, NEVER neon, NEVER 3D or CGI or Pixar, NEVER glossy plastic. Use the reference ONLY for the illustration STYLE.

An ISOLATED OBJECT STUDY on a plain flat warm cream field, empty edge to edge, with a soft shadow beneath.

SUBJECT: one tall stack of loose cream PAPER SHEETS sitting on the floor, seen from slightly above so both the front edge and the flat TOP of the stack are clearly visible. The entire stack is well inside the frame with generous empty cream space above it.

It must be obviously PAPER and never a solid block: every individual sheet edge is drawn as its own fine line up the whole height, hundreds of separate leaves, with the tiny natural unevenness of real paper along the sides, a few sheets sitting a hair proud of their neighbours. Soft, light, flexible paper, not wood, not stone, not a plank, not a beam, not a carved column.

The work is good: the sheets are crisp, clean and square, the corners sharp, the stack neatly squared like a well-kept ream.

Not one sheet has ever been taken. No gap anywhere in the column, no sheet pulled part way out, no leaning, no slump.

Lying openly across the flat top of the stack, and gathered in a clear soft ring on the floor all around its base, is a visible layer of pale grey DUST, thick enough to read plainly as dust rather than shadow. A long time has passed and nobody has touched it.

The top of the stack is completely bare. Nothing rests on it. Nothing is built from it.

Calm, still, immaculate, quiet. Not messy, not toppling, not ruined, not garbage. No people, no figures, no hands. No landscape, no horizon, no sky. No text, no letters, no numbers, no writing on any sheet.

READABLE SURFACES FACE THEIR READER: any book, page, letter, scroll or sign a character is reading or writing faces THAT CHARACTER, never the camera. Compose over-the-shoulder or from behind so the surface genuinely faces them. Any handwriting is abstract handwriting-like line work with NO real readable letters.

NO USER INTERFACE ANYWHERE: no windows, menu bars, buttons, icons, toolbars, panels, form fields, cursors, floating rectangles or screenshot-like elements. Screens carry only soft glow or vague painterly shapes.
